items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever go up around Betsy Coles? Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Up in the garden, did you see?
Yeah. Did you ever go up around Betsy Coles? Oh, yeah.
I used to play every Sunday at Lincoln Park for Buddy Boulder. Oh, yeah? The balloon used to go up. Used to send the balloon up. We played on the inside at night for the dance.
